description: Client-side leaderboard/member encode + parse vectors. These pin the parts of the leaderboard surface that do NOT require a live board on the server: query-string encoding for board reads, request-body encoding for member writes, and response parsing. The stateful happy paths (ranking, seasons, min/max acceptance) are pinned separately by the scope:"http" cases in ../http/cases.json. Three sections: `encodeQuery` (read params -> query string, presence-exact like series/cases.json — every key listed must appear with that string value, every key not listed must be absent), `encodeBody` (write inputs -> request JSON body, presence-exact on fields with values passed through byte-verbatim), and `parse` (a response body -> typed fields; `kind` selects the schema). Numeric values (value/total/memberValue/percentile) are decimal/integer STRINGS on the wire and MUST stay strings — never parsed to a native float/int (arbitrary precision; see the bignum entry). Loader contract lives in README.md.

encodeQuery.name: board-read-all-params
encodeQuery.note: GET /v1/counters/{key}/leaderboard?limit&offset&order&epoch. All four are passed through as strings; order is one of asc|desc, epoch/limit/offset are non-negative integers rendered without separators.

encodeQuery.name: board-read-defaults-omitted
encodeQuery.note: No params set -> no query string at all (server applies its own defaults). Presence-exact: the empty object means every optional key is absent.

encodeQuery.name: window-read-passthrough
encodeQuery.note: GET /v1/counters/{key}/leaderboard?window=7d returns a WindowLeaderboard. `window` reaches the query verbatim.

encodeQuery.name: window-invalid-value-local-reject
encodeQuery.note: `window` is a fixed enum (1h|6h|12h|1d|7d|30d). An SDK that exposes the windowed read validates it client-side and rejects a bad value with the 'validation' taxonomy type before issuing the request. Error case: has `expect.taxonomy`, no `query`.

encodeBody.name: member-add-amount-only
encodeBody.note: POST /v1/counters/{key}/members/{member}/add body. Only `amount` set: metadata and occurredAt MUST be absent from the body (presence-exact).

encodeBody.name: member-add-full
encodeBody.note: amount + metadata + occurredAt all present; each value passes through byte-verbatim (amount is an arbitrary-precision integer string, never reformatted; metadata is opaque).

encodeBody.name: member-submit-value-and-mode
encodeBody.note: POST /v1/counters/{key}/members/{member}/submit body. value + mode; metadata and occurredAt absent.

parse.name: leaderboard-sum-with-total
parse.note: A sum board carries `total`; entries are ranked (competition rank: ties share, next skips). `value`/`total` stay decimal strings. `metadata` is present only on entries that have it. One entry value overflows i64 to pin no-native-int parsing.

parse.name: leaderboard-min-without-total
parse.note: A min/max/latest board has NO `total` (total is meaningful only for sum boards). Parsing MUST tolerate its absence (the field is optional in openapi.yaml Leaderboard).

parse.name: window-leaderboard
parse.note: A sum-mode WindowLeaderboard: carries `window`, `effectiveStart`/`effectiveEnd` (the floored range actually summed) and a `total`. `mode` is required on every WindowLeaderboard. WindowEntry has no metadata/updatedAt. See `window-leaderboard-score-mode` for a score board, which has NO `total`.

parse.name: window-leaderboard-score-mode
parse.note: A score-mode (min/max/latest) WindowLeaderboard has NO `total` — a sum of best values is meaningless, so the server omits it (openapi.yaml: `total` is null on score boards). Parsing MUST tolerate its absence rather than defaulting it to zero or failing. `order` defaults to `asc` for `min` (fastest-first). Entries rank the window-best value.

parse.name: member-value-accepted
parse.note: The body returned by a member add/subtract/submit that changed the standing value. `memberValue` is this member's value; `value` is the board total (present on sum boards). Both stay strings.

parse.name: member-value-rejected
parse.note: A min/max submit that did NOT beat the standing best: memberAccepted=false, memberValue is the KEPT best (not the rejected submission). SDKs surface this without throwing.

parse.name: member-snapshot
parse.note: GET /v1/counters/{key}/members/{member}. `percentile` is a scale-2 STRING (e.g. "83.33"); parsing it to a float would lose the trailing-zero contract and is banned. `rank` is a competition rank.

parse.name: member-removed
parse.note: The body returned by DELETE /v1/counters/{key}/members/{member}. `value` (board total after removal) is present on sum boards.
